stats.note: prospects_scanned counts curated literature pointers + Beyond CRISPR corpus rows actually processed in suite runs — not fabricated web crawls.

investigations.question: Can multi-scale relational search recover distributed biological information-processing architectures without rewarding cutter resemblance?
investigations.motivation: AI co-occurrence discovery of unusual enzymes is a method peer; search one abstraction level higher for sense→encode→store→respond systems.
investigations.observation: Fixture suite scored candidates across molecular→evolutionary bands with anti-bias floors first; CRISPR kept as baseline.
investigations.known_explanations: CRISPR spacer memory; CBASS/Thoeris second-messenger immunity; DGRs; retrons; piRNA; TA; epigenetics; prions; integrons; pAgo.
investigations.novel_hypothesis: Distributed relational search can recover known architectures as positive controls and surface genuinely unexplained gap cassettes without Infinite Octave confirmatory goals.
investigations.prediction: Separable encode vs effector alleles (positive-control class) and lagged isogenic dissociations (gap class) falsify cutter-only framing.
investigations.null_hypothesis: Apparent architectures reduce to annotation artifacts, HGT debris, or already-adequate published mechanisms with no useful unified information job.
investigations.controls: Anti-bias floors; forbidden confirmation tokens; declaredWinner=null; C1 never gap lead.
investigations.analysis: Suite regenerates with all_pass; literature scan curated (not PRISMA).
investigations.result: Protocol operational; rediscovery of CBASS as positive control required honesty correction; gap shortlist C11–C13 retained.
investigations.alternative_explanations: Novelty inflation if known mechanisms labeled as discovery; selection bias in curated fixtures.
investigations.confidence: medium-high for protocol; low for wet-lab novelty
investigations.next_action: Phase 2b live Lattice blind sessions; C11 wet-lab when authorized

investigations.question: Is cyclic oligonucleotide immune signaling (CBASS/Thoeris) a newly discovered architecture under Beyond CRISPR search?
investigations.motivation: Initial queue wording overstated C4 novelty.
investigations.observation: Literature already describes phage detection → CD-NTase/TIR → cyclic nucleotide messenger → effector → cell fate; large surveys exist.
investigations.known_explanations: Cohen 2019 CBASS; Ofir 2021 Thoeris; Lowey effector chemistry; extensive CBASS catalogs.
investigations.prediction: If treated as positive control, protocol should recover distributed info-flow without claiming new biology.
investigations.null_hypothesis: C4 remains a novelty discovery claim.
investigations.test_method: Literature adequacy re-score; role reclassification to positive_control; ultimate questions must not lead with C4 discovery.
investigations.controls: publishedExplanationAdequacy raised; novelty demoted; gap leads separate.
investigations.analysis: C4 reclassified positive_control_framework_validation; discovery lead moved to unexplained gaps.
investigations.result: Hypothesis of C4-as-new-biology falsified / downgraded to rediscovery validation.
investigations.next_action: Keep C4 as framework validation only

investigations.question: Do ART-class unusual RT + partner + long-repeat cassettes implement a lagged sense→encode→store→alter-future-behavior loop?
investigations.motivation: Gap discovery criterion: mechanism not previously recognized; Anthropic ART-class function unresolved at survey time.
investigations.observation: Components co-occur; complete information loop not adequately explained as CRISPR/DGR/retron/CBASS.
investigations.known_explanations: Selfish mobile debris; assembly artifact; unfinished annotation of known writer class.
investigations.novel_hypothesis: Cassette writes a partner-dependent intermediate after priming that changes later challenge outcomes.
investigations.prediction: After priming, WT shows lagged infection/mobile-element change vs RT-dead and partner-dead; product ≠ DGR VR or retron msDNA.
investigations.null_hypothesis: No separable intermediate and no lagged phenotype — debris.
investigations.controls: Long-read locus validation; allele panel; DGR/retron exclusion; kill-if-fails tree.
investigations.analysis: Computational triage only; wet lab not authorized/executed in this seat.
investigations.result: OPEN — E3 prediction formulated; E4 experimental validation pending.
investigations.alternative_explanations: Known DGR/retron after better annotation; sequencing artifact.
investigations.confidence: low–medium as architecture claim; high as gap priority
investigations.next_action: Await human authorization for wet-lab collaboration; run Phase 2b blind Lattice sessions for independent queues

investigations.question: Can a leak-free Phase 2b blind prompt support live BYOK discovery without naming fixture leads?
investigations.motivation: Operator-owned live lane separate from CI fixtures.
investigations.observation: Prompt audit passes with zero forbidden leaks; receipt template requires antiBiasFirst and null winner.
investigations.prediction: Live sessions that rediscover only fully characterized CBASS will be labeled rediscovery, not gap.
investigations.null_hypothesis: Prompt leaks fixture IDs or positive-control names.
investigations.controls: Forbidden leak list; journey surfaces required for suite pass.
investigations.analysis: Export operational; live session not claimed as executed in CI.
investigations.result: Infrastructure ready; autonomousProcessRunning=false until operator runs Lattice session.
investigations.confidence: high for tooling; n/a for biology
investigations.next_action: Operator paste prompt at /lattice-chat and archive receipt
